card.headline: Stop saying "very small"
card.sub: Say "tiny" - or one of 9 other words

beats.speech: Stop saying very small. Say tiny. Here are ten better words: five for small things, and five for small amounts and chances.

beats.label: small things
beats.speech: Part 1. Five words for small things.

card.headline: Tiny
card.meaning: extremely small; the most common word

beats.speech: Tiny. It means extremely small; the most common word. "They live in a tiny apartment."

card.headline: Minuscule
card.meaning: extremely small in size or amount

beats.speech: Minuscule. It means extremely small in size or amount. "Add a minuscule amount of salt."

card.headline: Microscopic
card.meaning: too small to see without a microscope

beats.speech: Microscopic. It means too small to see without a microscope. "Microscopic creatures live in the water."

card.headline: Miniature
card.meaning: much smaller than the normal size, like a small copy

beats.speech: Miniature. It means much smaller than the normal size, like a small copy. "He built a miniature train."

card.headline: Compact
card.meaning: small and using very little space
card.example: "A compact car is easy to park."

beats.speech: Compact. It means small and using very little space. "A compact car is easy to park."

card.headline: Which word is it?
card.question: Too small to see without a microscope: ___
card.answer: Too small to see without a microscope: microscopic

beats.speech: Which word is it? Too small to see without a microscope. Microscopic, or miniature? | Microscopic. Microscopic creatures live in the water.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
They live in a tiny apartment.
Add a minuscule amount of salt.
Microscopic creatures live in the water.
He built a miniature train.
A compact car is easy to park.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | They live in a tiny apartment. | Add a minuscule amount of salt. | Microscopic creatures live in the water. | He built a miniature train. | A compact car is easy to park.

beats.label: small amounts and chances
beats.speech: Part 2. Five words for small amounts and small chances.

card.headline: Slight
card.meaning: very small in degree; not serious

beats.speech: Slight. It means very small in degree; not serious. "I have a slight headache."

card.headline: Slim
card.meaning: very small, for a chance or a hope
card.example: "We have a slim chance of winning."

beats.speech: Slim. It means very small, for a chance or a hope. "We have a slim chance of winning."
Minimal. It means very small; the least possible. "The storm caused minimal damage."

card.headline: Negligible
card.meaning: so small that it is not important

beats.speech: Negligible. It means so small that it is not important. "The difference in price is negligible."

card.headline: Meager
card.meaning: very small in amount; not enough

beats.speech: Meager. It means very small in amount; not enough. "He lives on a meager salary."

card.headline: Which word is it?
card.question: So small that it is not important: ___
card.answer: So small that it is not important: negligible

beats.speech: Which word is it? So small that it is not important. Negligible, or meager? | Negligible. The difference in price is negligible.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
I have a slight headache.
We have a slim chance of winning.
The storm caused minimal damage.
The difference in price is negligible.
He lives on a meager salary.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | I have a slight headache. | We have a slim chance of winning. | The storm caused minimal damage. | The difference in price is negligible. | He lives on a meager salary.
Quick tip: whenever you need another word for any word, look it up on another word for dot net.

card.headline: Which word will you use next time?

beats.speech: That's ten words to use instead of very small. Which one will you use next time? Write it in the comments.
